scripts.develop: npm run generate:components && concurrently --raw --kill-others-on-fail --names backend,components,ui --prefix-colors blue,magenta,green "npm start -w reflecta-backend" "npm start -w reflecta-components" "npm run wait:components && npm start -w reflecta-ui"
scripts.lint: npm run generate:components && eslint "*.js" "scripts/**/*.js" && npm run lint --workspaces
scripts.lint:fix: npm run generate:components && eslint "*.js" "scripts/**/*.js" --fix && npm run lint:fix --workspaces
scripts.pre-commit: cross-env FORCE_COLOR=true lint-staged && npm run pre-commit --workspaces
scripts.pre-push: node ./scripts/branchCheck.js && npm run lint && npm run typecheck
scripts.typecheck: npm run generate:components && npm run typecheck --workspaces
scripts.wait:components: node -e "const url='http://localhost:3003/remoteEntry.js'; const started=Date.now(); const timeout=60000; const poll=async () => { try { const response=await fetch(url, { method: 'HEAD' }); if (response.ok) process.exit(0); } catch (error) {} if (Date.now() - started > timeout) { console.error('Timed out waiting for ' + url); process.exit(1); } setTimeout(poll, 1000); }; poll();"
